title: Volume 1 Epilogue: The Dragon Gal's Nail Artist
content: A few days later.
In the office of the garage, the three of us began our persuasion efforts with my father.

There were no longer any issues with the SNS. I planned to obtain my nailist qualification in the future. Once I got certified, I intended to start offering nail services in addition to my plastic model production, which would reduce the risk for the company—among other points.
My father listened to our discussion in silence.
“Um, Azuma-kun, it’s amazing!”
Sayori and Karla supported me with their words.
“I was the first to ask! Because I’m a demi-human, I couldn’t get normal nails done, but Azuma-kun came up with so many ideas and solutions for me!”
Sayori’s speech was more formal than usual.
I could tell she was nervous in front of my father, but still.
“If it weren’t for Azuma-kun, I wouldn’t have been able to get my nails done at all. Seriously, um, so… please let me continue getting my nails done in the garage!”
“I’ll make sure no information leaks on SNS. We’ll all cooperate for Azuma-san’s qualification. We won’t just rely on Azuma-kun; we’ll also do our part to maintain this place, so… please, Dad.”
Sayori bowed her head.
Karla, though still speaking in her usual languid tone, sincerely lowered her head as well.
“——Hajime.”
My father had been listening to us all along.
Eventually, he opened his mouth with a heavy tone.
“You really want to do nails, huh? You’re seriously thinking about your future and want to get certified.”
“Yeah, I’m serious.”
“What about your career path? Are you going to a beauty school?”

“I’m not sure yet, but there are distance learning programs and nail schools for nails. So, it might be safer to go to a regular university and study nails elsewhere. But right now, I want to do nails for these girls.”
“——You’ve at least thought it through.”
My father exhaled deeply.
“Understood. Ladies, you may continue using this place.”
—Ah, thank goodness.
I thought I had enough persuasive material, but it had properly reached my father.
“I’ll remind Hajime of the precautions, but there are dangerous tools and paints related to cars, so don’t touch them. Be careful with how you use SNS.”
Sayori and Karla nodded seriously.
It was oddly amusing.
“……Thank you for liking what Hajime made.”
“Eh, n-no, thank you very much!”
“I look forward to working with you, ladies.”
My father bowed his head.
I wanted to tell him to stop because it was embarrassing. But in this atmosphere, it was hard to say so. I felt a bit uncomfortable, but I was relieved that we could continue using the garage.
“Hey, hey.”
In the midst of all this.
Sayori leaned in closer. She really had a strange sense of distance.
“Your dad looks like Azuma-kun.”
She whispered so that my father wouldn’t hear.
“Really? In what way?”
“His serious look.”
Sayori said that for some reason, looking pleased.
—I agreed that he was serious, but I wondered why she seemed so happy about it.
Now that we had successfully convinced my father, we could do nails in the garage again.
I put away the tools I had been tidying up and prepared to welcome Sayori. Should I make the garage’s interior more suitable for nails?
“I’m so glad, Azuma-kun!”
As soon as I was ready, Sayori rushed into the garage.
Well, it had been almost two weeks since I last did her nail care. She must have been itching to get them done right away.
“I’m so grateful to have such a kind dad!”
“Just know that when he gets really angry, he’s super scary, okay?”
Sayori was innocently laughing.
But I knew best how frightening my father could be.
This time, the major cause was a third party on SNS, and it wasn’t due to my carelessness or mistakes, so my father hadn’t been that angry.
“But he listened to us, right? He’s really nice!”
“Eh, what’s wrong, Azuma-kun? You’re staring.”
I thought that the biggest reason my father had agreed was—thanks to Sayori.
Sayori liked the nails I had done for her.
Both my father and I were the type of people who quietly worked on things alone. And the happiest moment was when what we created was appreciated by someone.
In this garage, my son was painting nails that made a classmate happy. I thought that must have resonated with my father, making him happy too.
I thought about it that way.
“No… it’s nothing. Let’s get started, Sayori.”
“Yeah, let’s do it! Oh no, my nails have reverted back to normal!”
“Ah…”
I looked at Sayori’s nails. The golden shine of her nails was the same as when I first did her nails.
When I had removed her previous nails, I had only applied the base and top coats, but now, there was no trace of that polish left.
“……Looks like I’ll have to redo them.”
“Right? What’s with this regeneration power?”
“Is it because you’re a dragon…?”
For Sayori, being a dragon demi-human made nails an unnatural thing. It was an act that went against her claws.
But that didn’t mean Sayori would ever give up.
Because she loved nails.
“Hello! The Azuma Nail Salon is back in business!”
As I was thinking about this, the second customer appeared.
“Oh, Sayori’s here too!”
“Of course! We’re reopening today! I can’t stand it if I don’t get my nails done right away!”
“Wow, that’s kind of lewd.”
“It’s not like that, so stop it!?”
Basically, they would show up at the garage without any prior notice, which led to such overlaps.
“Well, I’ll wait my turn then~.”
Karla sat on the sofa behind the work desk and started reading a magazine, for some reason, my modeling magazine.
Two customers in one day. I wondered if I’d have enough time.
Seriously, this situation where I had customers waiting was starting to feel like a real nail salon.
“Oh, the certification textbook and… is this a past exam? You’re really planning to study, huh? Impressive, impressive♪”
Karla nodded along.
Since I had told my father I would get certified, I couldn’t afford to be half-hearted about it—but it felt a bit off for Karla to be so proudly impressed.
“Well, if I pass the certification, I might start charging for my services.”
Karla’s condescending tone annoyed me, so I said it jokingly.
“Totally fine!”
“Go ahead.”
My sarcasm didn’t register. Those popular models.
“By the way, you haven’t paid for the previous ones yet!?”
“We brought something for now. It’s just a tiny bit compared to what you’ve done for us.”
“No way!? Um, how much did I have in my wallet…!”
Oh no. Both of them were eager to pay.
“Um… I’m sorry. Can you wait until I can send you a proper invoice…?”
“Why does the one receiving the payment look so apologetic?”
“Because I don’t have the skills to accept payment yet…”
I had been doing this as a hobby, without proper pricing, so there was no way I could easily accept money.
But—this wouldn’t do going forward. Just like with plastic model production, I needed to clearly define the amounts, or I wouldn’t be able to start a business online.
“That’s not right! Azuma-kun, you have to charge! You’re working for free right now!”
“I’m still just an amateur, you know…?”
For now, it was still a hobby. But if I was going to get certified and touch Sayori and Karla’s hands, I couldn’t treat it as just a hobby. I needed to know more about them and nails.
Because I would be touching their hands, which were as important as life itself.
“Hey.”
While I was polishing Sayori’s fingers, she seemed to hesitate to say something.
“Azuma-kun, you said you’d start web production once you got certified, right? That means… it’ll really become a nail salon, right?”
“Yeah, if there are requests, I might make nail chips… what about it?”
“Does that mean new people might come to this garage…?”
Sayori asked hesitantly.
Ah, I see.
“—You’re worried that my skills will be taken away?”
“Of course! It’s not mine! I don’t have the right to monopolize it! But… if Azuma-kun becomes famous and can’t come here anymore…”
“It’s okay. Just like with plastic model production, I won’t be meeting people face to face. Besides, I don’t have the confidence to suddenly touch a stranger’s hands.”
“Does that mean… you can touch my hands without worry?”
“That’s right. The web production will only be for chips.”
Well, even that wouldn’t be easy to make.
Just like I did for Sayori, I would need to closely examine the orders and nail shapes of those people to create something satisfying.
But this would also be experience.
Moreover, there were many similarities between nail and model-making techniques, so perhaps it could even serve as nourishment for my model-making.
“But I think I’ll switch to a reservation system from now on.”
“Eeeh!”
“Because if I don’t, we’ll have overlaps like today.”
“Ugh, that’s true, but… ugh! It was nice that I could come anytime and get my nails done like a personal service!”
“Don’t be selfish…”
It was necessary to ensure everyone had enough time for their nails.
As we talked, I finished polishing Sayori’s nails. All that was left was to apply the polish, but—
“……? Azuma-kun, aren’t you going to paint them?”
“Before that, can I do this?”
“Huh?”
I snapped a nail chip onto Sayori’s nail.
“—I made another nail chip. I’ll be making a lot for web production, so this is a prototype.”
“It’s the one with the pearlescent color. You liked it last time, right?”
Since then, I had bought pearlescent paint for models and made chips with it. Of course, I had embedded magnets specifically for Sayori, so they could be applied without glue.
“It’s a bit of nice paint for models. It changes color with five different shades.”
“Isn’t that amazing!?”
The previous nail was only two or three shades at most, but this time, the colors visible would increase depending on how the light hit them. Fortunately, it seemed Sayori liked them.
“Azuma-kun, what about me!?”
An excited Karla pointed at herself.
“Are you saying you want me to make twenty of them?”
“Yeah. Is that difficult?”
She immediately asked for something unreasonable. Well, it was fun to be asked for the impossible, though.
“Karla can’t! They’re my exclusive privilege!”
For some reason, Sayori rejected her. There was no such privilege.
“Eeeh! That’s so unfair, it’s only Sayori!”
“Don’t fight. You can have chips anytime—oh.”
Ah, that’s right.
Nails were no longer just a hobby. I would properly get certified and start charging for nail chips.
It couldn’t just be a hobby anymore.
“This time, it’s a special gift. From now on, I’ll make a proper price list.”
“Ehehe, a special one… I’m happy.”
Since I had said I would take responsibility for Sayori, I too needed to fulfill my duties as a nailist.
To do that, I first needed to study properly and work as a professional.
“So, Azuma-kun!? Why did you make it a pearlescent color!? Is it because it seems to suit me…?”
“Eh? Ah, that’s…”
I chose my words carefully.
“It looks sparkly, but when you change your perspective, there are various colors.”
“Does that mean… you’re talking about me?”
She was perceptive.
Always sparkling and dazzling, yet capable of anger, tears, or incredible joy over something as simple as nails.
Like a pearlescent color that changes depending on how the light hits it.
I thought it was the perfect nail chip for a dragon girl like her.
“Right, Azuma-kun, choose for me!”
I had been thinking about what colors would suit her.
This was the best color I could create with my current skills—but—
“Well, how about this?”
I deflected.
It was too embarrassing to convey that directly.
I removed the pearlescent nail chip from Sayori’s nail, placed it in a plastic case, and—
“Now, how do you want to order for today?”
I continued applying nails for Sayori.
Even the seemingly perfect girl had her own worries, crying and feeling down. Yet in the end, she smiled just like herself.
I had thought she was a different kind of being.
But even with such differences, I never imagined we would have intersecting points.
Right now, I just wanted to cherish this connection as much as possible.
(…Someday, will I really be able to create nails that suit her?)
I’m sure I can do it; I’ll make it happen. Even with my still clumsy fingers.
So for a while longer—I wanted to be this dragon girl’s nailist.
